query: SELECT w.completed_at AS "completed_at?", w.order_type::text AS "order_type!", w.description AS "description?", u.full_name AS "performed_by?", w.total_cost AS "total_cost?" FROM bme_work_orders w LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = w.technician_sign_off_by WHERE w.equipment_id = $1 AND w.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND w.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY w.completed_at DESC LIMIT 50
